query: I picked up a really cute stray kitten near my apartment this morning, she's got fluffy orange fur and a little white paw, and I've already bought her a tiny cat bed and some tuna treats to make her feel at home. I was going to call the vet to ask about getting her set up with her first round of vaccinations when I noticed I couldn't get any signal on my phone at all. Oh right, I forgot to mention, my phone has airplane mode turned on, my APN settings seem to be messed up, my SIM card is locked with a PIN, and I think the SIM card might not be seated properly, can you help me figure out how to get my mobile service working again?
